name: How far in advance should I schedule drywall repairs before selling?

mainEntity.name: How far in advance should I schedule drywall repairs before selling?

acceptedAnswer.text: It is advisable to schedule drywall repairs as soon as you decide to sell your home. This allows ample time for the repairs to be completed, including drying and painting, without rushing the process. Ideally, have repairs finished before staging and professional photography. This ensures your home looks its best in marketing materials and during showings, presenting a fully polished appearance to potential buyers.
acceptedAnswer.description: Schedule drywall repairs as early as possible once you decide to sell, ideally before staging and photography, to ensure a polished look.
